01-01-desktop: Bliss desktop, taskbar, four desktop buttons, tray 40% and clock as expected. The My Documents label touches the left edge.
01-02-start-menu: Start menu opens: Terminal, Notes, wobbly.rs, Chart, Page, All Programs, Log Off, Turn Off. Each program row shows its command (chora-notes) as grey subtitle.
01-03-terminal-open: A terminal window opens at the top left (about 25,25) over the desktop icons with a shell prompt in /home/user/notes and a task button foot.
01-04-shell: ls lists friday.md, release.md, todo.txt and cat friday.md prints the Friday list; typing at 9 characters a second.
01-05-notes-open: Notes opens over the terminal, offset down and right, second task button.
01-06-wobbly-drag: A drag of the Notes title bar to the lower right: the window follows; the bend of the jelly effect is barely visible in the still.
01-07-taskbar-terminal: A click on the foot task button brings the terminal to the front; its title bar is blue.
01-08-muted: A click on the speaker: the tray reads Muted.
01-09-unmuted: A second click: the tray reads 40% again.
01-10-paperclip-balloon: The paperclip appears at the bottom right with the balloon: Good morning! Your notes for Friday are ready. The word ready. wraps alone.
01-11-chat-open: A click on the paperclip opens the chat balloon: Chat with a helper, Close, 1 Atlas working, the sentence, a field.
01-12-chat-collapsed: Close: only the paperclip and its balloon with the last sentence remain; the sentence shows again.
01-13-chat-reopened: The chat opens again with the same content.
01-14-helper-picked: Atlas picked by a click: header Atlas working Tidy notes (1/2), Stop, Close, transcript; long lines cut with an ellipsis.
01-15-field-click: A click into the field shows the caret.
01-16-typed: Please also add Monday. shows in the field.
01-17-sent: After Return the field is empty and the transcript shows no line for the sent message.
01-18-question: Question card: Atlas wants to write the file notes.txt, detail line, Alt+Y or Alt+N, Yes and No; the field says A question is waiting.
01-19-answered: After the click on Yes the card is unchanged until the agent closes it; the click gives no feedback of its own.
01-19b-card-closed: The fake agent sent done: the card is gone and the chat is back (2/2).
01-20-f1: F1 shows nothing in xp: no key overlay, no change in the picture (the terminal shows no ^[OP this time, since the chat holds the keyboard).
